env_paras.num_jobs: Legacy environment job count; current competition-data training reads real instances.
env_paras.num_mas: Legacy machine count; current competition-data training reads real instances.
env_paras.batch_size: Legacy batch size for old training code.

model_paras.hidden_size_ope: Hidden dimension used by MLP modules.
model_paras.action_dim: Actor output dimension for legacy modules.
model_paras.epsilon: Numerical stability value used by the model.

train_paras.min_lr: Minimum learning rate for linear schedule.
train_paras.target_kl: Early-stop PPO epoch when approximate KL is too large.
train_paras.save_timestep: Legacy save interval; current trainer saves by best fulfillment_rate_mean.
train_paras.max_minibatch_tokens: Optional token budget per minibatch; 0 disables this limit.
train_paras.simulator_backend: Training simulator backend; SCI trainer uses the array backend.
train_paras.num_workers: Number of complete episodes collected per training iteration.
train_paras.num_envs: Number of complete array-simulator episodes collected per training iteration.
train_paras.rollout_steps: Deprecated; complete-episode trainer ignores transition truncation.
train_paras.target_transitions: Deprecated; complete-episode trainer ignores transition budgets.
train_paras.rollout_device: Device used for rollout policy inference; CPU is the default to avoid Windows GPU TDR crashes.
train_paras.update_device: Device used for PPO parameter updates.
train_paras.resume: Use auto to resume from result/last_checkpoint.pt when present, or none to start fresh.
train_paras.train_patterns: Glob patterns used when train_instances is empty.
train_paras.train_instances: Fixed training instance filenames; CLI --instances has higher priority.
train_paras.instance_selection: Instance selection mode: fixed, round_robin, or random.
train_paras.discard_penalty: Normalized penalty coefficient for discarded orders.
train_paras.tardiness_penalty: Optional tardiness penalty coefficient; 0 disables it.
train_paras.progress_reward_coeff: Optional progress reward coefficient; 0 disables it.
train_paras.dense_progress_reward: Optional dense progress reward; 0 disables it.
train_paras.order_top_k: Maximum candidate orders per task type in hierarchical actor.
train_paras.fluid_mode: Training-side fluid feature mode: heuristic, cached_lp, or off.
train_paras.fluid_recompute_interval: Deprecated for event-driven cached_lp; kept for config compatibility.
train_paras.fluid_time_limit: Fluid-model solver time limit in seconds.
train_paras.fluid_threads: Solver thread count; 0 lets solver choose.
train_paras.fluid_profile: Record fluid solve count and seconds.
train_paras.use_sparse_attention: Enable lightweight self-attention over sparse legal action candidates.
train_paras.sparse_attention_scope: Sparse attention scope: pair only, or pair_order to also attend over top-k order candidates after pair selection.
train_paras.sparse_attention_heads: Number of sparse candidate attention heads.
train_paras.sparse_attention_dropout: Dropout probability used by sparse candidate attention.
train_paras.viz: Enable Visdom logging; CSV logging always stays enabled.
train_paras.viz_update_interval: Push metrics to Visdom every N training iterations.
train_paras.viz_metrics: Metric names plotted as independent Visdom windows.
train_paras.parallel_iter: Legacy instance replacement interval for old training code.

test_paras.num_sample: Number of samples for legacy DRL-S.
test_paras.num_average: Number of averaging loops for legacy DRL-G.
test_paras.public_ins: Whether test instances are public benchmarks.
test_paras.data_path: Relative path of the test set.
